fact: On 23 July 2024 DGCI technicians and taxpayers met in Bissau on putting taxes on the Kontaktu platform, which lets taxpayers declare and pay at any time by bank transfer, Orange Money or Mobile Money, and the DGCI director-general said all taxes, fees and contributions would be introduced on it.
title: Técnicos da DGCI e contribuintes debatem a introdução de impostos na plataforma digital "Kontaktu"
